text: Ironvale Athletic asserted control at 24' by exploiting transition spaces through a deep defensive block and rapid direct vertical passing, consistent with their 5-3-2 counter-attacking setup. Their pressing trigger involved absorbing Redmond Rovers’ high press (PPDA 18.0) and then launching quick counters, resulting in 8 final third entries and 2 shots with a combined xG of 0.16 in just 8 minutes. Ironvale’s rest-defense mechanism allowed safe ball recovery in deeper areas, facilitating progressive passes that broke Redmond's high line and disrupted their quick circulation. The effectiveness of this approach is further reflected in Ironvale’s three shots on target and 0.36 xG in the last 10 minutes prior, indicating a sustained field tilt despite holding only 48.1% possession.
